entities.summary: Nicola Renzi is a Sammarinese politician and educator who served as Secretary of State for Foreign and Political Affairs from 2016 to 2020. A member of Future Republic, he previously served as Captain Regent from 2015 to 2016, alongside Lorella Stefanelli.
